paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score (in percentage) of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across five different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) ranging from 80 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal axis lists the five datasets. For each dataset, three bars are grouped together, representing: MADLLM (light green), MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM without skip embedding (orange). Across all datasets, the full MADLLM model consistently achieves the highest F1 scores, ranging approximately from 91% to 97%. The ablated versions generally perform worse: removing feature embedding leads to the most significant drop in performance, particularly on SWaT (F1 ~86%) and PSM (F1 ~94% vs. ~97% for full model), while removing skip embedding has a milder impact. The bars are not sorted by performance but are grouped by dataset, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding. The chart visually demonstrates the contribution of both feature and skip embeddings to the overall performance of MADLLM.
